name: Turret
description: An autonomous security turret: a low, wide white armored head with twin barrels and a red sensor slit, on a black turntable and pedestal.

made_with.settings: Ultra, 8K textures, PBR, main view only

notes: Regenerated at Meshy's highest quality (Bryson, 2026-10-11), full resolution: 693,226 triangles, 1.58 x 0.90 m, barrels toward -X. Meshy painted the visor slit dark, so Claude added a glowing red bar in it (z 1.115 m). The first, smart-topology turret is in sources as meshy-t2.glb. Lowered 2026-10-11 (Bryson): Meshy remesh to 38255 triangles, textures shrunk to 2K with prep_prop.py --max-texture 2048; looks the same, loads far faster.
